train: Original train partition excluding all reserved localization workers
development: Original dev excluding reserved workers, already consumed adaptively in v1/v2
reservation: Original test and all reserved localization workers remain untouched
selection: Highest exact development matches, then fewest rules, then policy order
domains: For each family, compile observed input words plus up to 256 frequent training words per target role. Flat-tree vocabulary guard, at most 512 distinct words. Not a complete slot grammar; unknown words abstain. No teacher labels during inference. No reduction of global no-error checks, independent admission or six-example minimum.
metrics: Exact intent and all ordered slot values. Every dev utterance remains in denominator; report unseen texts/values, composite values, and absent role signatures.
scope: Research diagnostic after explicit training counterexamples, not a full M1 approval. Vocabulary constraints are a supplied hypothesis class with learned public words, not open concept discovery. Development adaptive, independent localizers/test unused. No LLM/RSS/energy claim.
